text: Suddenly my left arm feels numb
My right leg is weak and heavy
my face is drooping on one side
I have chest pain when I walk
There's a tightness in my chest
My words are coming out slurred
My daughter said I seemed confused last night
I blacked out in the kitchen
I fell and hit my head
I feel weak and tired for three days
Never fainted, but I feel slow
I feel a bit breathless climbing stairs

note: Malay: 'I was confused yesterday' - expected miss for rules-only extraction
